ui.about_lead: ASFAN – the Association for the Study of Unidentified Aerospace Phenomena – invites you to the course “Introduction to Ufology” (fourth series).
ui.about_p1: The course covers the basics of unidentified aerospace phenomena: the latest political and military developments, disinformation, abductions, folkloric, religious and paranormal connections, shamans, attempts at explanation, investigation methodology, false UFOs, international organisations in the field, and more.
ui.about_p2: The course runs via ZOOM, generally every two weeks on Wednesdays from 19:00 to 21:00, with one hour of presentation and one hour of discussion, between 18 November 2026 and 26 May 2027, avoiding public holidays and student exam periods.
ui.about_p3: Participation is free, and at the end of the course, participants with no more than three absences may request a diploma.
ui.about_p4: Places are limited. Enrol by sending an e-mail to {MAIL} by 17 November 2026. Those admitted (generally in order of application) will receive the ZOOM link for each talk at their e-mail address.

faq: How much does it cost to take part?
How do I get the ZOOM link?
Those admitted receive the ZOOM link for each talk at their e-mail address.
By sending an e-mail to {MAIL} by 17 November 2026. You can also use the form on the enrolment page, which prepares the e-mail for you.
In what order are participants admitted?
Places are limited; those admitted are, in principle, chosen in order of application.
Yes. At the end of the course, participants with no more than three absences may request a diploma.
How long is a session and when does it take place?
On Wednesdays, between 19:00 and 21:00: one hour of presentation and one hour of discussion. Sessions take place, in principle, every two weeks, avoiding public holidays and student exam periods.

The latest political and military developments, disinformation, abductions, folkloric, religious and paranormal connections, shamans, attempts at explanation, investigation methodology, false UFOs, international organisations in the field, and more.
topics: What do we know, and what remains a mystery?
How do we analyse a case?
Who deals with the phenomenon worldwide?
In science, art, film and society.
What do we learn from the phenomenon?

sessions.title: The basics: unidentified aerospace/anomalous phenomena (UAP/UFO)
sessions.text: Unidentified aerospace/anomalous phenomena (UAP/UFO), the basics: aerial, underwater, outer space, transmedium. Daytime, nighttime and radar sightings. Characteristics, landings. Aggressive UFOs.

sessions.title: Political-military history 1942–2017
sessions.text: Political-military history 1942-2017, nuclear connections, crashes, conflicts, projects, Blue Book, Hynek, regulations. Secrecy, disinformation, taboo, ridicule, media complicity, the UFO mythology. Also among the Russians, British, French, South Americans etc.

sessions.title: After 2017: Congress, Pentagon, NASA, AARO
sessions.text: After 2017: Congress, the Pentagon, NASA, AARO etc. Private initiatives. Has the American military industry used UFO debris? Russia, China and ICER, other associations. Official UFO structures. The latest declassifications.
chips: UFO debris in the American military industry?

sessions.title: Close encounters of the 3rd–4th kind
sessions.text: Close encounters of the 3rd-4th kind. Contacts, contactees, abductions, scenario, genetic experiments, indoctrination, special characteristics, evidence, abductions without return. Hopkins, Mack etc. Mutilations, cryptozoology, reservations?

sessions.title: The ancient history of the phenomenon
sessions.text: The ancient history of the phenomenon, folkloric connections, iele (Romanian folklore fairies), dwarves, Magonia, magic circles and crop circles, Vallée.

sessions.title: The connection with the paranormal
sessions.text: The connection with the paranormal. The CRV remote viewing technique, channeling, Akasha, reincarnations? Spiritual aspects, journeys of the spirit, shamans, techniques, Mack.
chips: Spiritual aspects, journeys of the spirit

sessions.title: Remarkable Romanian cases
sessions.text: Remarkable Romanian cases. History, ufologists, associations, magazines.

sessions.title: Religious connections
sessions.text: Religious connections, sects, holy apparitions, UFOs in the Bible?, heavenly abductions, genetic experiments, satanic? Vatican, Vallée.

sessions.title: Ancient civilisations
sessions.text: Ancient civilisations, Silurian, Atlantis, Nibiru, Anunnaki, Pleiadians, reptilians. Paleocontact, ooparts, cyclopean constructions, mummies.

sessions.title: Possible explanations
sessions.text: Possible explanations: time travellers? Intraterrestrials? Etc. Two extraterrestrial hypotheses, hypercivilisations, conditions, self-destruction, non-intervention. Cultural hypnosis, limits, possible consequences.

sessions.title: Attempts at disclosure
sessions.text: Attempts at disclosure. Declassifications. Will there be a contact? What will it look like? Under what conditions? The current attitude towards disclosure: military, researchers, religious people, the general public.
chips: Will there be a contact? What will it look like?
Attitudes to disclosure: military, researchers, religious people, the general public

sessions.title: More Romanian cases and open presentations
sessions.text: More Romanian cases. Open presentations. Films, photographs etc.

sessions.title: Investigation methodology and false UFOs
sessions.text: Methodology, how we investigate UAP cases, ASFAN resources (database, data archive etc.). How to recognise/tell apart a UFO, false UFOs, aircraft, satellites, photographs and films, fakes.
